name: cast
title: The Cast
kicker: Six systems that know nothing of each other
html:
The Cast

Forgescm:GitHub or GitLab, behind a gateway that serves scm: forms
Watcherwatcher:Waits until the pull request offers scm:merge, then answers
CIci:A HEART face on a real Jenkins: builds, deploys, answers when done
Previewlibrary:Where Jenkins deploys the build: the library app
Devenv:Where a commit that passed its smoke test is promoted
Release deskhr:Where a person asks for a release. ARTIE runs here, and the replies live here

Each speaks HEART. ARTIE crosses between them by following links, and waits on two of them with RISE: an ask, and a reply resource the answer comes back to.
say: Six systems, and none of them knows the others. The forge is GitHub or GitLab, behind a small gateway that serves scm: forms. The watcher waits until a pull request offers scm:merge, and then answers. CI is a HEART face on a real Jenkins. Preview is where Jenkins deploys the build. Dev is where a passing commit gets promoted. And the release desk is where a person asks for a release, and where ARTIE runs. Each one speaks HEART. ARTIE crosses between them by following links.
